name: Rock On
description: As you walk, the ground hardens underneath your feet, dirt replaced with hard rock.
effect: Place a quarry tile and populate it. Gain 2 stone.

name: Marble Canyon
description: A striped canyon in the distance catches your eye.
effect: Place a basin tile and populate it. Gain 2 marble.

name: Grass Surrounds You
description: Lush grass surrounds you at every angle as far as the eye can see.
effect: Place a plains tile and gain 1 sigil.

name: Vast Land
description: You stumble through the woods and happen upon a big patch of land.
effect: Place a triple tile. Populate any resource tiles that appear. Add two resources from one tile of your choosing to your personal inventory.

name: Phone a Friend
description: It's taking ages to clear your way through a thicket. If only you had some help...
effect: If you are adjacent to a friend, place down a double tile. Otherwise, place a random single tile and gain 1 sigil.

name: Swamped
description: The grass gets taller and the soil more moist. As the croaking of frogs fill the air, you stop and decide to take a look around.
effect: Place a swamp tile and gain 1 sigil.

name: The Mountain Climb
description: You take a long hike over a difficult inclining path.
effect: Place a mountain tile and gain 1 sigil.

name: Choose Your Path
description: You hit a crossroads—to your left, the world opens up to a flat field of flowers; to your right, the dirt dries up into craggling rocks.
effect: Choose your path. If you visit the meadow, place a plains tile. If you follow the craggling rocks, place a quarry and populate it.

name: Feel The Burn
description: As you climb higher upon steepening hills, the heat becomes sweltering. The ground begins to quake as the sky rumbles.
effect: Place the volcano under you and roll 1d6. On a 4 or above, the adjacent tiles are safe. On a 3 or lower, remove 1d6 resources from each adjacent tile.

name: At The Peak
description: There's a sharp incline on the ground you walk. The air gets thin as you find yourself closer to its snowy peak.
effect: Place a mountain tile and gain 1 sigil.

name: Crow's Eye
description: You stumble across an opening in the hillside. Seeing a faint glimmer inside, you decide to investigate.
effect: Place a cave tile and populate it. Gain 2 crystal.

name: Stony Paths
description: Things are looking a little rocky...
effect: Place a quarry, a cave, or a basin tile, and populate it. Gain 2 additional resources from your chosen tile.

name: Lost Your Marbles
description: A land of marble lies in front of you.
effect: Place a basin tile and populate it. Gain 2 marble.

name: Into The Dark
description: You find yourself at the mouth of a cave.
effect: Place a cave tile and populate it. Gain 2 crystal.

name: Green Giants
description: You are plunged into a world of wood.
effect: Place a forest or a plains tile. If the forest is chosen, populate it and gain 2 additional wood.

name: Fork in the Road
description: A path splits ahead. Where will you go?
effect: Place a quarry or a plains tile. If the quarry is chosen, populate it and gain 2 additional stone.

name: The Land Expands
description: You find a wide expanse of land in front of you.
effect: Place a double tile. Populate any resources that appear. Add two resources from one tile of your choosing to your personal inventory.

name: Tree-mendous
description: You find a forest.
effect: Place a forest tile and populate it. Gain 2 wood.

name: Plain(s) and Simple
description: You stumble across a vast field of green.
effect: Place a plains tile and gain 1 sigil.

name: Welcome to the Forest
description: You find a forest.
effect: Place a forest tile and populate it. Gain 2 wood.

name: Welcome to the Scrublands
description: The grass thickens and the soil hardens. Vegetation seems to thrive in this strange land.
effect: Place a scrubland tile and gain 1 sigil. If the tile is adjacent to a forest, gain 1 wood.

name: Watch Your Step!
description: Lush vegetation gives way to craggly stone and steep drop-offs.
effect: Place a basin tile and populate it. Gain 2 marble.

name: Magical Quarry
description: You find a quarry, but there's a violent magical energy that prevents you from approaching. Will you tame it?
effect: Place down a quarry tile and roll a d6. On a 2 or below, all adjacent tiles with resources lose 1.

name: Lost in the Haze
description: The fog rolls in on an early morning, dew settling or your clothes as you walk through the squelching mud.
effect: Place a swamp tile and gain 1 sigil.

name: Find Your Footing
description: You find yourself in a swamp—and your lower half sinking into a pit of mud.
effect: Place a swamp tile and roll a d6. On a 2 or below, you're stuck here for another round. Otherwise, gain 1 sigil.

name: The Forest's Gift
description: The forests are rather plentiful today, and they're more than willing to share their gifts to the surrounding land.
effect: Place a scrubland tile. If it is adjacent to a forest, gain 1 wood.

name: Wood You Like More?
description: The woodlands call to you.
effect: Place a forest, scrublands, or a swamp tile. If the forest is chosen, populate the tile and gain 2 additional wood.

name: Scrublands or Quarry?
description: In the midst of a scrublands, you find a quarry.
effect: Place a quarry tile or a scrublands tile. If the quarry is chosen, gain 2 stone, then roll a d6. On a 2 or below, populate it with half as many resources.

name: O Great Heavens, A Mountain Range!
description: A series of jagged hills covers the skyline in front of you.
effect: Add 2 adjacent mountain tiles and gain 1 sigil.
